channel.title: Maccy
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.description:
• Redesigned image/text preview as a slideout panel with a toolbar, openable via `⌃Space`.
  • Added a button to copy OCR text from an image.
  • Added a setting to toggle auto-open preview.
  • Added a setting to toggle a HEX color swatch.
  • Show image dimensions in the preview.
  • Improved memory usage and performance.
  • Fixed `⌃K` (kill-to-end) when already on the first item.
  • Raised the pop-up above Chrome autofill.
  • Keep the pop-up constrained to the active screen .
  • Refresh the app icon after the source app is updated.
  • Fixed open preferences warning text overflow on long localizations.
  • Fixed an issue when transient pasteboard types from VS Code and Notes would create duplicate items.
  • Improved Persian/Croatian/Uzbek/Spanish translations.
